Definition: Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Aram or Arameans = "exalted"; n pr m; 1) Aram or Syriathe nation; 2) the Syrian or Aramean people; Aram = "exalted"; n m; 3) fifth son of Shem; 4) a grandson of Nahor; 5) a descendant of Asher
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
